class.name: OcgGCMakesegment2d
class.brief_description: This class implements construction algorithms for line segments in the plane. The result is a `Geom2d_TrimmedCurve`. A `GC_MakeSegment2d` object provides a framework for: - defining the construction parameters; - running the construction algorithm; - querying the construction status and the resulting segment via `Value()`.

method.name: from_gp_Pnt2d_const_ref_gp_Pnt2d_const_ref
method.description: Creates a segment between two points.

method.name: from_gp_Pnt2d_const_ref_gp_Dir2d_const_ref_gp_Pnt2d_const_ref
method.description: Creates a segment on a line defined by point and direction. The segment starts at `theP1` and ends at the orthogonal projection of `theP2` onto that line.

method.name: from_gp_Lin2d_const_ref_double_double
method.description: Creates a segment on a line between two parameter values.

method.name: from_gp_Lin2d_const_ref_gp_Pnt2d_const_ref_double
method.description: Creates a segment on a line between point parameter and target parameter.

method.name: from_gp_Lin2d_const_ref_gp_Pnt2d_const_ref_gp_Pnt2d_const_ref
method.description: Creates a segment on a line between projections of two points.

method.name: Value
method.description: Returns the constructed line segment. Exceptions StdFail_NotDone if no line segment is constructed.
